reading.body:
Data Foundry - Texas 1 publishes 130,000 square feet of technical space but no megawatt figure, placing it outside the 13 Texas facilities that disclose power capacity and account for 389 MW of tracked state capacity.

Floor area alone does not predict AI workload capacity. A facility of 130,000 square feet is substantial, not marginal, but watts per rack determine what compute density the building can sustain. Without a published power figure, Texas 1 cannot be ranked against peers in the state or assessed for suitability to training and inference loads that drive infrastructure demand.

The operator's specification page lists no certifications, no redundancy tier, and no details on grid connection or backup power. Austin's grid region has faced scrutiny for capacity and reliability, but this facility's resilience characteristics and utility arrangements remain unpublished. For readers evaluating AI infrastructure, Texas 1 is an established large building whose actual compute relevance cannot be determined from available data.
